graph.summary: Empagliflozin → Sodium/glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) → renal glucose absorption → Hyperglycemia → Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

evidence.snippet: Empagliflozin is a new inhibitor of sodiumglucose cotransporters type 2 (SGLT2) for the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Its specific action inhibits glucose reabsorption in renal tubules and thus promotes glucosuria.
evidence.explanation: Empagliflozin directly inhibits the SGLT2 cotransporter, reducing its activity.

paper.title: [EMPAGLIFLOZIN (JARDIANCE) :Nw SGLT2 COTRANSPORTER INHIBITOR FOR TREATING TYPE 2 DIABETES].

evidence.snippet: By inhibiting these proteins, SGLT2 inhibitors increase urinary glucose excretion (UGE) that leads to fall in plasma glucose concentrations and improvement in all glycemic parameters.
evidence.explanation: Confirms SGLT2 inhibition as the mechanism of action of empagliflozin.

paper.title: Glucose Lowering Efficacy and Pleiotropic Effects of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2 Inhibitors.
paper.journal: Advances in experimental medicine and biology

evidence.snippet: Inhibitors of sodium/glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT2) are currently in clinical use for type 2 diabetes (T2D) treatment due to their anti-hyperglycemic effect exerted by the inhibition of glucose reabsorption in the kidney.
evidence.explanation: SGLT2 drives renal glucose reabsorption; its inhibition reduces this process.

paper.title: Impact of an SGLT2-loss of function mutation on renal architecture, histology, and glucose homeostasis.

evidence.snippet: SGLT2 cotransporters are responsible for reabsorption of 90 % of the glucose filtered by the kidney.
evidence.explanation: SGLT2 is the primary transporter responsible for renal glucose reabsorption.

paper.title: Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics and Clinical Use of SGLT2 Inhibitors in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Chronic Kidney Disease.

evidence.snippet: These agents reduce hyperglycemia by decreasing the renal glucose threshold and thereby increasing urinary glucose excretion.
evidence.explanation: Reduced renal glucose reabsorption increases urinary glucose excretion and lowers plasma glucose, thereby reducing hyperglycemia.

paper.title: SGLT2 inhibition: efficacy and safety in type 2 diabetes treatment.

evidence.snippet: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors medications lower plasma glucose by inhibiting glucose reabsorption in the proximal tubule of the kidney independent of insulin.
evidence.explanation: Inhibiting renal glucose reabsorption lowers plasma glucose (reduces hyperglycemia).

paper.title: Effects of sodium glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors on the kidney.

evidence.snippet: In type 2 diabetes, the maladaptive upregulation of sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) protein expression and activity contribute to the maintenance of hyperglycemia.
evidence.explanation: Hyperglycemia is a cardinal manifestation of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

paper.title: Glucose Lowering Efficacy and Pleiotropic Effects of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2 Inhibitors.
paper.journal: Advances in experimental medicine and biology
